reviews.text: So nice, thank you very much 🥰 …

Witnessed the incident today which I see
someone else has also left a review of here. Not good, the person who was at work should not be allowed to work with animals.

I have had my Chihuahua at Hundelede for the past year, and I couldn't be happier! He gets nail trims, walks and lots of company with other dogs. Every time we pass the daycare outside of opening hours, he refuses to go any further – he simply wants to go back in! That says it all about how well he enjoys it. Fantastic work done at both St. Hanshaugen and Grünerløkka – safe, professional and with genuine love for the dogs. Highly recommended! 🐾
Our dog Molly loves being at Hundelede. The owner Johnny is fantastic with dogs. The place is highly recommended!! ❤️
The dog is doing well, it is much better and more pleasant for him to be here than at home alone while we are at work, recommended ☺️
My dog ​​did not have a good experience here, took her home and will never go back.
Johnny and co. take good care of the dogs :)
So nice, thank you very much 😃 …
